name: Sorted Rasterization of Projected Tetrahedra
aliases: GPU DVR for unstructured data via sorted PT
Radiance Mesh Rendering via Hardware Rasterization
Sorted Rasterization of Projected Tetrahedra — GPU DVR for unstructured data via sorted PT, Tet-by-Tet Ray Casting
definition: A method for GPU DVR algorithms for unstructured data involving sorted rasterization of projected tetrahedra.
summary: Sorted Rasterization of Projected Tetrahedra is a GPU-based direct volume rendering method for unstructured data that achieves interactive rates by rasterizing tetrahedra as distinct primitives, avoiding explicit per-pixel ray-casting.
